segments.name: Acquisition and Management of Stream Interests
segments.description: Acquires and manages metal stream purchase agreements on producing and development stage mines, providing upfront deposit payments for the right to purchase metals.
segments.evidence: A metal stream is a purchase agreement that provides, in exchange for an upfront deposit payment, the right to purchase all or a portion of one or more metals produced from a mine, at a price determined for the life of the transaction by the purchase agreement.

segments.name: Acquisition and Management of Royalty Interests
segments.description: Acquires and manages non-operating royalty interests on production, development and exploration stage mining projects.
segments.evidence: Royalties are non-operating interests in mining projects that provide the right to revenue or metals produced from the project after deducting specified costs, if any.

revenueModel.text: Royal Gold earns revenue by purchasing metals under stream agreements at contractually determined prices and by receiving royalty percentages of revenue or production from mine operators.
revenueModel.evidence: Our financial results are primarily tied to the price of gold and, to a lesser extent, the prices of silver and copper, together with the amounts of production from our production stage stream and royalty interests.

changes.text: In 2025, Royal Gold acquired Sandstorm Gold Ltd. and Horizon Copper Corp., adding stream and royalty interests to its portfolio.
changes.evidence: On October 20, 2025, we acquired all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Sandstorm Gold Ltd. ("Sandstorm") and Horizon Copper Corp. ("Horizon"), collectively referred to as "the Transaction."
